title: Alternative Dispute Resolution Ii
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a private method of resolution, chosen by the parties themselves as an effective way of putting an end to disputes between them, without recourse to the courts of law."
Arbitration is a private method of resolution, chosen by the parties themselves as an effective way of putting an end to disputes between them, without recourse to the courts of law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an impartial international forum providing facilities for arbitration of international investment disputes."
The ICSID is an impartial international forum providing facilities for arbitration of international investment disputes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to "public policy" as the basis of the bar."
Courts often refer to "public policy" as the basis of the bar.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of resolving business disputes between or among transnational parties through the use of one or more arbitrators rather than through the courts."
International commercial arbitration is the process of resolving business disputes between or among transnational parties through the use of one or more arbitrators rather than through the courts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a private method for settlement of disputes."
ADR is a private method for settlement of disputes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a determination on the merits by an arbitration tribunal."
The award is a determination on the merits by an arbitration tribunal.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the best‐known example of a jurisdiction that has declared an award enforceable notwithstanding the fact that it had been set aside in the country of origin."
France is the best‐known example of a jurisdiction that has declared an award enforceable notwithstanding the fact that it had been set aside in the country of origin.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the French acronym for "Organisation pour l'Harmonisation en Afrique du Droit des Affaires", which translates into English as "Organization for the Harmonization of Business Law in Africa"."
OHADA is the French acronym for "Organisation pour l'Harmonisation en Afrique du Droit des Affaires", which translates into English as "Organization for the Harmonization of Business Law in Africa".
fib: ______ is a leading method for resolving disputes arising from international commercial agreements and other international relationships.
International arbitration
International arbitration is a leading method for resolving disputes arising from international commercial agreements and other international relationships.
______ are the 'judges' in the case and no party would wish to upset the judge, particularly before the proceedings have even commenced.
arbitrators
The arbitrators are the 'judges' in the case and no party would wish to upset the judge, particularly before the proceedings have even commenced.
______ is the ultimate power determining the form, structure and other details of the arbitration.
Party autonomy
Party autonomy is the ultimate power determining the form, structure and other details of the arbitration.
______ is an entity on its own and has its own laws and regulations.
country chosen
The country chosen is an entity on its own and has its own laws and regulations.
______ means faster growth, higher living standards, and new opportunities through commerce.
Trade
Trade means faster growth, higher living standards, and new opportunities through commerce.
______ is a very significant topic in law relating to arbitration, and has been discussed world‐over, including at the UNCITRAL itself.
limit to arbitrability
The limit to arbitrability is a very significant topic in law relating to arbitration, and has been discussed world‐over, including at the UNCITRAL itself.
______ is the foundation of international commercial arbitration.
arbitration agreement
The arbitration agreement is the foundation of international commercial arbitration.
